summary: Completed frontend testing of View All scroll feature. All 7 features tested and working correctly. The View All buttons for each category (UK News, Sports, Business, Health, Entertainment) correctly scroll to article #3 (index 2) - the first article NOT shown on the homepage.
critical_code_review_comments: handleCategoryChange function correctly stores pending scroll target with article index based on HOMEPAGE_ARTICLE_COUNTS
pendingScrollRef properly tracks scroll target and clears after scroll completes
Scroll useEffect correctly waits for loading to complete before scrolling
data-testid attributes on CompactArticleCard components enable reliable scroll targeting
Scroll offset adjustment (-100px) accounts for fixed header
context_for_next_testing_agent: View All scroll feature fully tested. All category View All buttons correctly scroll to the first article not shown on homepage (article #3 at index 2).

homepage_loads_correctly.details: Homepage loads with all 8 category sections visible: Cheshire News, UK News, Business, Health, Sports, Tech, Science, Entertainment

view_all_uk_news_scroll.details: Clicking 'View All UK News' button scrolls to article #3 (index 2) - the first article NOT shown on homepage. UK News shows 2 articles on homepage.

view_all_sports_scroll.details: Clicking 'View All Sports' button scrolls to article #3 (index 2) - the first article NOT shown on homepage. Sports shows 2 articles on homepage.

view_all_business_scroll.details: Clicking 'View All' button in Business section scrolls to article #3 (index 2) - the first article NOT shown on homepage. Business shows 2 articles on homepage.

view_all_health_scroll.details: Clicking 'View All' button in Health section scrolls to article #3 (index 2) - the first article NOT shown on homepage. Health shows 2 articles on homepage.

view_all_entertainment_scroll.details: Clicking 'View All Entertainment' button scrolls to article #3 (index 2) - the first article NOT shown on homepage. Entertainment shows 2 articles on homepage.

category_tab_selection.details: Category tabs in header (UK News, Sports, Business, Health, Entertainment, Tech, Science) work correctly - clicking changes the active category filter

implementation_details.scroll_mechanism: Uses pendingScrollRef to store target article index, then scrolls after loading completes using data-testid selectors
implementation_details.scroll_target: Article at index equal to homepage count (e.g., UK News shows 2 articles, so scroll to index 2 which is article #3)
